name: Develop React Primitive Component
description: Create a new React primitive component for the react-renderer vessel

tasks.description: Read existing primitive components to understand patterns

prompt.template:
Read the existing primitive components in {{vesselPath}}/src/primitives/ to understand the patterns used. Look for:
1. Import patterns
2. Props interface structure
3. Rendering patterns
4. How primitives handle children
5. Styling approach

Summarize the patterns found.

tasks.description: Read the type definitions for the primitive

prompt.template:
Read {{vesselPath}}/src/types.ts and find the interface definition for {{primitiveName}}Primitive. Extract:
1. The interface name
2. All properties and their types
3. Required vs optional properties
4. Any constraints or validation rules

Create the {{primitiveName}} primitive component at {{vesselPath}}/src/primitives/{{primitiveType}}.tsx.

Requirements:
1. Import React and necessary dependencies
2. Define props interface matching {{primitiveName}}Primitive from types.ts
3. Implement the component following patterns from existing primitives
4. Handle all required props
5. Provide sensible defaults for optional props
6. Include proper TypeScript types
7. Export the component

Follow the exact patterns observed in existing primitives.

Update {{vesselPath}}/src/primitives/index.ts to export the new {{primitiveName}} primitive component.

Add the import and export statements following the existing pattern.

tasks.description: Add the primitive to PrimitiveRenderer switch case

prompt.template:
Update {{vesselPath}}/src/components/PrimitiveRenderer.tsx to handle the '{{primitiveType}}' case.

Add a case in the switch statement that renders the {{primitiveName}} component with the appropriate props.

metadata.learningObjective: Teach MiniBob to create React primitives following established patterns
